title: America Has a Problem in Africa: China

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·罗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其周围文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 甚至早在黑胶唱片时代的夜店当DJ时，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 每晚你都要带着300件最珍爱的藏品去上班，把DJ台变成一个由美丽的50年历史艺术品组成的流动快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 立即在您喜爱的播客平台上收听由爱彼呈现的《重构者》。

sentences.en: From New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》的我，是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is a daily.
sentences.zh: 这是“每日新闻”。

sentences.en: Vice President Kamala Harris's trip last week to Africa was designed to send a simple message to its governments and people.
sentences.zh: 美国副总统卡玛拉·哈里斯上周对非洲的访问旨在向其政府和人民传递一个简单的信息。

sentences.en: China is not your friend.
sentences.zh: 中国不是你们的朋友。

sentences.en: We are.
sentences.zh: 我们才是。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Abdi Latif Dahir on why the United States is picking this moment to make that case and what it has to lose if African countries choose China.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事阿卜迪·拉蒂夫·达希尔将探讨为什么美国选择在这个时刻表明这一立场，以及如果非洲国家选择中国，美国将失去什么。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, April 6th.
sentences.zh: 今天是4月6日，星期四。

sentences.en: Abdi, tell us about this very high-profile trip that the Vice President made last week to Africa.
sentences.zh: 阿卜迪，请给我们讲讲副总统上周对非洲进行的这次备受瞩目的访问。

sentences.en: So this past week, Vice President Kamala Harris visited three different African countries.
sentences.zh: 就在过去这一周，副总统卡玛拉·哈里斯访问了三个不同的非洲国家。

sentences.en: That is Ghana, Tanzania and Zambia.
sentences.zh: 也就是加纳、坦桑尼亚和赞比亚。

sentences.en: I am incredibly honored to be with you here in Ghana.
sentences.zh: 我很荣幸能来到加纳与大家在一起。

sentences.en: As soon as she stepped off the plane, she really got started on this charm offensive that was meant to bring into the fold,
sentences.zh: 她刚一下飞机，就开始了旨在拉拢人心的魅力攻势，

sentences.en: to woo the leaders and the people of the different nations that she visited.
sentences.zh: 去争取她所访问的各个国家的领导人和人民。

sentences.en: I am optimistic about the future of the world because of you, the woman who will shatter every glass ceiling,
sentences.zh: 我对世界的未来感到乐观，因为有你们，有将打破每一层玻璃天花板的女性，

sentences.en: the entrepreneur who will identify the next digital breakthrough, the activiSt.
sentences.zh: 有将发掘下一个数字突破口的创业者，还有活动人士。

sentences.en: She talked about the continent's young people and the potential that they have in shaping the future of the world.
sentences.zh: 她谈到了非洲大陆的年轻人以及他们在塑造世界未来方面所具有的潜力。

sentences.en: And one of the ways that she showed that was by talking and meeting a lot of young people, including artists.
sentences.zh: 她展现这一点的方式之一，就是与许多年轻人（包括艺术家）交谈和会面。

sentences.en: I am very excited that this artist, this incredible artist, is going to be part of my playliSt.
sentences.zh: 我非常高兴这位艺术家，这位杰出的艺术家，将成为我播放列表的一部分。

sentences.en: She even posted a Spotify list of her favorite African music and met with artists, including one named Amarei.
sentences.zh: 她甚至在Spotify上发布了她最喜欢的非洲音乐播放列表，并与包括一位名叫阿玛雷伊在内的艺术家见了面。

sentences.en: I just can't thank you enough for the inspiration that you are providing.
sentences.zh: 我简直无法充分表达对你们所带来的启发的感激之情。

sentences.en: Please, I can't thank you enough.
sentences.zh: 拜托，我真的感激不尽。

sentences.en: There's so many people.
sentences.zh: 有太多的人了。

sentences.en: And perhaps the most notable stop on this trip was a really personal one that she did in Zambia.
sentences.zh: 而这次访问中最引人注目的，或许是她在赞比亚进行的一场充满个人色彩的访问。

sentences.en: It is wonderful to be in Zambia and to be back in Zambia.
sentences.zh: 很高兴来到赞比亚，再次回到赞比亚。

sentences.en: She gave a speech talking about her family's ties to the country.
sentences.zh: 她发表了一篇演讲，谈到了她的家族与这个国家的渊源。

sentences.en: My grandfather was a civil servant in India.
sentences.zh: 我的祖父曾是印度的公务员。

sentences.en: And in 1966, shortly after Zambia's independence, he came to Lusaka.
sentences.zh: 1966年，在赞比亚独立后不久，他来到了卢萨卡。

sentences.en: Her grandfather worked there as a public servant for India.
sentences.zh: 她的祖父曾在那里担任印度的公职人员。

sentences.en: And Vice President Kamala Harris would visit him as a child.
sentences.zh: 副总统卡玛拉·哈里斯在童年时曾去看望过他。

sentences.en: I remember being here and just how it felt and the warmth and the excitement that was present.
sentences.zh: 我记得来到这里时的感觉，以及这里所洋溢的热情和兴奋。

sentences.en: But Kamala Harris's visit is just one in the latest string of top American officials who have visited the continent this year.
sentences.zh: 但卡玛拉·哈里斯的访问只是今年访问非洲大陆的一长串美国高级官员中的最新一位。

sentences.en: Just over the past several months, we've had Secretary of State Antony Blinken.
sentences.zh: 就在过去几个月里，我们迎来了国务卿安东尼·布林肯。

sentences.en: We've had First Lady Jill Biden come through, Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen.
sentences.zh: 第一夫人吉尔·拜登来访，财政部长珍妮特·耶伦也来了。

sentences.en: And before that, we had the United States Ambassador to the UN, Linda Thomas-Greenfield, who also visited several African nations.
sentences.zh: 在此之前，美国常驻联合国代表琳达·托马斯-格林菲尔德也访问了几个非洲国家。

sentences.en: I have to say, that's quite a lineup.
sentences.zh: 我必须说，这阵容相当强大。

sentences.en: I can't really remember the last time I heard a roster of diplomatic visits that deep, all in a span of just a few months.
sentences.zh: 我真记不清上一次听到如此强大力度的外交访问阵容是在什么时候了，而且全都是在短短几个月内。

sentences.en: I think the big elephant in the room is China and the feeling among American officials and the Biden administration that the United States has ceded a lot of ground to China when it comes to its engagement in Africa.
sentences.zh: 我认为房间里最大的大象就是中国，美国官员和拜登政府有一种感觉，即美国在参与非洲事务方面已经向中国让出了大量地盘。

sentences.en: Explain that.
sentences.zh: 请解释一下。

sentences.en: So over the past two decades, China has become the major trading partner for many countries in the continent.
sentences.zh: 在过去的二十家里，中国已经成为非洲大陆许多国家的主要贸易伙伴。

sentences.en: It is the largest fund of infrastructure projects in many African countries.
sentences.zh: 它是许多非洲国家基础设施项目最大的资金提供者。

sentences.en: A lot of those African countries are also home to rare earth minerals, which the United States and China both need in this big technological tussle that they are engaged in.
sentences.zh: 许多非洲国家也拥有稀土矿产，这是美国和中国在这场激烈的技术争夺战中所需要的。

sentences.en: And China, you know, has already been digging a lot of those.
sentences.zh: 而且你知道的，中国已经在开采其中的许多矿产了。

sentences.en: They've been processing and exporting them, essentially blocking out the United States.
sentences.zh: 他们一直在进行加工和出口，基本上把美国挡在了外面。

sentences.en: China has also been a major provider of educational scholarships to a lot of young African students.
sentences.zh: 中国也一直是向许多非洲年轻学生提供教育奖学金的主要提供者。

sentences.en: And so I think there's a feeling within the United States that here's a young continent that has the potential to shape geopolitics and wild economies in the decades to come.
sentences.zh: 因此，我认为美国国内有一种感觉，这是一个年轻的大洲，有潜力在未来几十年塑造地缘政治和世界经济。

sentences.en: And yet the United States has let China become the dominant force in those countries.
sentences.zh: 然而，美国却任由中国成为这些国家的主导力量。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: Basically, the Biden administration realizes that, in some sense, the future is Africa and China now owns that future.
sentences.zh: 基本上，拜登政府意识到，从某种意义上说，未来在非洲，而中国现在拥有这个未来。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Abdi, how did we get to this place where the U.S.
sentences.zh: 阿卜迪，我们是如何走到这一步的：美国

sentences.en: has ceded so much ground in Africa to China?
sentences.zh: 在非洲向中国让出了这么多的地盘？

sentences.en: So this begins around 1999 or 2000, at the time of the millennium.
sentences.zh: 这大约始于1999年或2000年，千禧年之际。

sentences.en: And China came out with this policy called the going out policy.
sentences.zh: 中国出台了一项名为“走出去”的政策。

sentences.en: And basically, a lot of it was about encouraging Chinese companies to go and invest abroad.
sentences.zh: 基本上，很大程度上是关于鼓励中国企业去海外投资。

sentences.en: And it was also an opportunity to bring a lot of the mineral resources that China needed, which were abroad back home.
sentences.zh: 这也是一个将中国所需的海外矿产资源带回国内的机会。

sentences.en: And we see the engagement between Africa and China quickly accelerate.
sentences.zh: 我们看到非洲和中国之间的交往迅速加速。

sentences.en: And then in 2013, China announced this incredibly ambitious project that ensured that its ties to the continent will be changed forever.
sentences.zh: 然后在2013年，中国宣布了一项雄心勃勃的项目，确保其与这片大陆的联系将永远改变。

sentences.en: This program, which is called the Belt and Road Initiative, is an infrastructural project that mirrors the Silk Road.
sentences.zh: 这个被称为“一带一路”倡议的项目是一个仿效丝绸之路的基础设施项目。

sentences.en: And it aims to stretch basically across the globe.
sentences.zh: 它的目标是基本上横跨全球。

sentences.en: And it's coming in to Africa, particularly, to build all these highways and ports and railways that essentially will connect ports to the inland,
sentences.zh: 它正在进入非洲，特别是为了修建所有这些高速公路、港口和铁路，基本上将港口与内陆连接起来，

sentences.en: you know, that would connect cities to the rural areas.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这将把城市与农村地区连接起来。

sentences.en: We're talking about a total investment of hundreds of billions of dollars.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的是数千亿美元的总投资。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And so very quickly, as the money from the Belt and Road program floods into African cities and African countries, what you start seeing is their visibility.
sentences.zh: 因此，随着“一带一路”项目的资金迅速涌入非洲城市和非洲国家，你开始看到的是它们的知名度。

sentences.en: They're very direct.
sentences.zh: 它们非常直接。

sentences.en: They're in your face.
sentences.zh: 它们就摆在眼前。

sentences.en: And very quickly, people are sort of like able to see and say, oh, yeah, this was actually built for us by China.
sentences.zh: 很快人们就能够看到并说，哦，是的，这实际上是中国为我们建造的。

sentences.en: China did this.
sentences.zh: 中国做了这个。

sentences.en: China did that.
sentences.zh: 中国做了那个。

sentences.en: And you quickly notice how much China was changing cities across the continent.
sentences.zh: 你很快就会注意到中国正在多么大地改变整个大陆的城市。

sentences.en: So China is literally building Africa's infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 所以中国简直是在建设非洲的基础设施。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是的。

sentences.en: You know, even in cities like Nairobi, where I am based, particularly over the past decade,
sentences.zh: 你知道，即使在像我所在的内罗毕这样的城市，特别是在过去十年里，

sentences.en: the way this city has completely transformed is very much, you know, synonymous with China and its arrival in the continent.
sentences.zh: 这座城市彻底转型的方式，很大程度上，你知道的，与中国及其来到这片大陆息息相关。

sentences.en: I used to, for instance, like study at a university on the other side of Nairobi.
sentences.zh: 例如，我过去常常在内罗毕另一头的一所大学学习。

sentences.en: And basically, the road that would go to that university was like a two-lane road.
sentences.zh: 基本上，通往那所大学的路就像是一条双车道公路。

sentences.en: And now it's one of the biggest highways in this region.
sentences.zh: 而现在它是这个地区最大的高速公路之一。

sentences.en: It's up to like eight different lanes.
sentences.zh: 它多达八个不同的车道。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And so whenever you think about how the traffic in Nairobi was so bad in the past and how there are all these highways and expressways that are opening up all across the city,
sentences.zh: 因此，每当你想到内罗毕过去的交通有多糟糕，以及所有这些在全市范围内开放的高速公路和快速路时，

sentences.en: everybody just thinks about China.
sentences.zh: 每个人想到的都是中国。

sentences.en: Everybody just thinks, oh, yeah, it used to take me this many hours to get to one place.
sentences.zh: 每个人都会想，哦，是的，我过去去一个地方需要花这么多小时。

sentences.en: But thank God for China.
sentences.zh: 但感谢上帝有了中国。

sentences.en: And Abhi, where was the United States during all of this?
sentences.zh: 阿卜迪，这一切发生时，美国在哪里？

sentences.en: As China is making these enormous investments that are clearly creating a tremendous amount of influence for it across Africa.
sentences.zh: 正当中国进行这些巨额投资，显然在整个非洲为其创造了巨大的影响力时。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: has always been there.
sentences.zh: 一直都在那里。

sentences.en: I think we shouldn't discount the fact that the United States is still the continent's largest aid donor, right?
sentences.zh: 我认为我们不应该忽视这样一个事实，即美国仍然是非洲大陆最大的援助国，对吧？

sentences.en: And the fact that, you know, they continue to be very pivotal in providing emergency food investments in health care.
sentences.zh: 而且他们继续在提供紧急粮食投资和医疗保健方面发挥着非常关键的作用。

sentences.en: But I think in many ways over the past two to three decades, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但我认为在很多方面，在过去的二三十年里，美国

sentences.en: has treated Africa less as a strategic partner and more as a problem to be solved.
sentences.zh: 对待非洲与其说是将其视为战略伙伴，不如说是将其视为一个需要解决的问题。

sentences.en: And the focus particularly has shifted towards dealing with a continent through a terrorism and a security lens.
sentences.zh: 重点尤其转向了通过恐怖主义和安全视角来处理与这片大陆的关系。

sentences.en: Explain that.
sentences.zh: 请解释一下。

sentences.en: So, for instance, you have the example of like countries like Somalia, where there's been an ongoing civil war for decades,
sentences.zh: 所以，例如，索马里等国家的例子，那里几十年来一直在进行内战，

sentences.en: and then the arrival of the terrorist group Al-Shabaab and all the troubles that they've caused in this region and beyond.
sentences.zh: 然后是恐怖组织“青年党”的到来以及他们在这个地区及其他地方造成的所有麻烦。

sentences.en: And so the relationship that the United States has with neighboring countries, including Kenya or Ethiopia or Djibouti,
sentences.zh: 因此，美国与包括肯尼亚、埃塞俄比亚或吉布提在内的邻国的关系，

sentences.en: is all about like how do we partner up to sort of like tackle this?
sentences.zh: 全都是关于我们如何合作来解决这个问题？

sentences.en: How do we make sure that the militaries in this region are professionalized?
sentences.zh: 我们如何确保该地区的军队实现职业化？

sentences.en: How do we help law enforcement build up intelligence infrastructure that would deny Al-Shabaab haven in the region?
sentences.zh: 我们如何帮助执法部门建立情报基础设施，剥夺“青年党”在该地区的避难所？

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以美国

sentences.en: is focused on building an infrastructure to fight terrorism, not on the kind of infrastructure projects that China is focused on,
sentences.zh: 专注于建立打击恐怖主义的基础设施，而不是中国所关注的那种基础设施项目，

sentences.en: which is the kind of bread and butter bridges, airports and dams that so many of these countries need.
sentences.zh: 也就是许多这些国家所必需的根本性的桥梁、机场和水坝。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And these countries, they do need the security support, you know, that would sort of like deter a lot of these terrorist groups.
sentences.zh: 这些国家确实需要安全支持，你知道的，这可以在某种程度上威慑许多这些恐怖组织。

sentences.en: But on a day-to-day basis, these big infrastructure projects that China is bringing, they're loved.
sentences.zh: 但在日常生活中，中国带来的这些大型基础设施项目备受喜爱。

sentences.en: They become these symbols, right, that a lot of people look at and appreciate.
sentences.zh: 它们成为了这些象征，对吧，许多人看到并对此表示赞赏。

sentences.en: And that's sort of like the conversation that you hear reverberating in many places across the continent.
sentences.zh: 这有点像你在非洲大陆许多地方听到回响的对话。

sentences.en: So presumably the United States has recognized what you're describing here for some time, that China has been, to put it undiplomatically, eating America's lunch in Africa.
sentences.zh: 所以据推测，美国有一段时间已经认识到你这里所描述的情况，即用不那么外交的话来说，中国一直在非洲抢夺美国的饭碗。

sentences.en: So when does the U.S.
sentences.zh: 那么美国是什么时候

sentences.en: decide that this is a problem that it has to do something about by dispatching all these top American officials, including Vice President Harris?
sentences.zh: 决定这是一个必须通过派遣包括副总统哈里斯在内的所有这些美国高官来采取行动的问题的？

sentences.en: So the real wake-up call comes after Russia's invasion of Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 真正的警钟是在俄罗斯入侵乌克兰之后敲响的。

sentences.en: And during that time, like, you know, the United States rallied countries across the world at the United Nations General Assembly to basically condemn the war.
sentences.zh: 在那段时间里，你知道的，美国在联合国大会上联合了世界各地的国家来基本上谴责这场战争。

sentences.en: A recorded vote has been requested.
sentences.zh: 已要求进行记名投票。

sentences.en: We shall now begin the vote in process.
sentences.zh: 我们现在开始投票程序。

sentences.en: And China, of course, did not condemn the war.
sentences.zh: 当然，中国没有谴责这场战争。

sentences.en: They did not vote for the resolution.
sentences.zh: 他们没有投票支持该决议。

sentences.en: Those in favor of draft resolution, please signify those against abstentions.
sentences.zh: 赞成决议草案的人请示意，反对者弃权者。

sentences.en: But also...
sentences.zh: 但还有……

sentences.en: The result of the vote is as follows.
sentences.zh: 投票结果如下。

sentences.en: Nearly half of African countries abstained or were absent from the vote to condemn Russia.
sentences.zh: 近半数的非洲国家在谴责俄罗斯的投票中投了弃权票或缺席。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有趣。

sentences.en: Which suggested a growing reluctance in many nations to accept an American narrative of what's right and what's wrong.
sentences.zh: 这表明许多国家越来越不愿意接受美国关于什么是对、什么是错的说法。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Because in this moment, it feels like African countries are, in a sense,
sentences.zh: 因为在此刻，感觉非洲国家在某种意义上

sentences.en: choosing more of a Chinese narrative of this Russian war in Ukraine than the American narrative of the Russian war in Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 比起俄罗斯在乌克兰战争的美国叙事，更多地选择了中国关于这场俄乌战争的叙事。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: And, you know, a lot of African countries or the leadership in those countries were basically putting out statements or lines of thinking that said that, you know,

sentences.zh: 这非常有趣，它可能意味着这些非洲国家可能成为世界上极其罕见且或许令人艳羡的典范，

sentences.en: that will not allow themselves to be overly influenced by just China or just the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他们绝不允许自己被单一的中国或美国过度影响。

sentences.en: In some ways, they will demand that both countries play a role in their lives, but that, one, not have necessarily the upper hand.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，他们会要求两国都在他们的生活中发挥作用，但任何一方都不一定占据绝对上风。

sentences.en: And perhaps that could spare them some of the exploitation that we have come to expect from these relationships.
sentences.zh: 也许这可以让他们免受我们对这些关系习以为常的剥削。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: One of the words that I continue to hear from African leaders that I speak to is the word agency.
sentences.zh: 我从与之交谈的非洲领导人那里听到最多的词之一就是“自主权”（agency）。

sentences.en: You know, these African leaders, they talk a lot about agency.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这些非洲领导人经常谈论自主权。

sentences.en: They talk a lot about being allowed to, like, trade with China and, like, work on health and development with the United States.
sentences.zh: 他们经常谈论被允许与中国贸易，并与美国在健康和发展方面合作。

sentences.en: And there is this sense of, like, why should we pick a side?
sentences.zh: 并且有一种感觉，就是我们为什么要选边站？

sentences.en: This is a largely developing continent.
sentences.zh: 这是一个大面积的发展中大陆。

sentences.en: There are different partners who are able to come in and solve different issues.
sentences.zh: 有不同的合作伙伴能够进来并解决不同的问题。

sentences.en: We will welcome them all.
sentences.zh: 我们欢迎所有这些伙伴。

sentences.en: As one official put it to me, he said that, you know, China will come and build the hardware and the United States will come and build the software.
sentences.zh: 正如一位官员对我说的那样，他说，中国会来建造硬件，而美国会来建造软件。

sentences.en: And both of those will complement each other and then benefit the people of the country.
sentences.zh: 这两者将相辅相成，从而造福这个国家的人民。

sentences.en: And they are not naive.
sentences.zh: 他们并不天真。

sentences.en: They know that the relationship they have with one side or the other will be fraught and complicated and complex.
sentences.zh: 他们知道自己与任何一方的关系都将充满摩擦、复杂和错综交织。

sentences.en: But for now, where they stand, they sense an opportunity and they want to take that opportunity.
sentences.zh: 但就目前而言，立足当下，他们感到了一个机会，并想要抓住这个机会。

sentences.en: Well, Abdi, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，阿布迪，非常感谢。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们对此深表感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wynna Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜·刘（Wynna Liu）。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times Games.
sentences.zh: 我编写《纽约时报》游戏部的字谜游戏“Connections”。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢试图捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽斯基（Sam Azersky）。

sentences.en: And I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我每天都创作游戏“Spelling Bee”和“Letterboxd”。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called Chromaesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“通感”的现象。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你刚刚听到的人这样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问nytimes.com斜杠games，今天就开始游玩。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: In a surprise defection with major implications,
sentences.zh: 在一场具有重大影响的意外倒戈事件中，

sentences.en: a Democratic state lawmaker in North Carolina has switched parties and given Republicans veto-proof supermajorities in both chambers of its legislature.
sentences.zh: 北卡罗来纳州的一名民主党州议员转换了党派，赋予了共和党在该州立法机构两院中拥有可推翻否决权的绝对多数席位。

sentences.en: Modern-day Democratic Party has become unrecognizable to me and to so many others throughout this state and this country.
sentences.zh: 现代民主党对我以及本州和全国的许多人来说已经变得面目全非。

sentences.en: The lawmaker, Tricia Cawtham, said she was leaving the Democratic Party over policy disagreements and because, she said,
sentences.zh: 这位名叫特里西娅·科瑟姆（Tricia Cotham）的议员表示，她离开民主党是因为政策分歧，并且因为她说，

sentences.en: she had been bullied by fellow Democrats for failing to fall in line with North Carolina's Democratic governor, Roy Cooper.
sentences.zh: 她因未能与北卡罗来纳州民主党州长罗伊·库珀（Roy Cooper）保持一致而遭到同僚民主党人的霸凌。

sentences.en: It became very clear to me early on in January that you better vote in line with everything Governor Cooper tells you to do.
sentences.zh: 我在1月份很早就清楚地意识到，你最好按照库珀州长吩咐你做的一切去投票。

sentences.en: All of this sense of control, I will not be controlled by anyone.
sentences.zh: 所有这些控制感，我不会被任何人控制。

sentences.en: Her defection may now allow North Carolina Republicans to, among other things, restrict abortion and voting rights across the state.
sentences.zh: 她的倒戈现在可能允许北卡罗来纳州共和党人采取行动，其中包括限制全州的堕胎权和投票权。

sentences.en: And, on Wednesday, House Speaker Kevin McCarthy stepped into the growing feud between the United States and China over Taiwan by meeting with Taiwan's president in California.
sentences.zh: 周三，众议院议长凯文·麦卡锡（Kevin McCarthy）在加利福尼亚州会见了台湾地区领导人，介入了美国与中国之间因台湾问题而不断升级的争端。

sentences.en: McCarthy became America's most senior elected official to meet with a Taiwanese president on American soil since the United States established diplomatic relations with China in 1978.
sentences.zh: 自从美国于1978年与中国建交以来，麦卡锡成为了在美国本土会见台湾总统的美国最高级别民选官员。

sentences.en: China argues that such meetings undermine its claims of control over Taiwan.
sentences.zh: 中国认为，此类会晤破坏了其对台湾的主权主张。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Shannon Lin, Sydney Harper, and Diana Nguyen, with help from Jessica Chung and Carlos Prieto.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由香农·林、悉尼·哈珀和戴安娜·阮制作，杰西卡·钟和卡洛斯·普里耶托提供了协助。

sentences.en: It was edited by M.J.
sentences.zh: 节目由M.J.

sentences.en: Davis Lin, with help from Devin Taylor, contains original music by Marion Lozano and Dan Powell, and was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 戴维斯·林剪辑，德文·泰勒提供协助，包含马里昂·洛萨诺和丹·鲍威尔的原创音乐，由克里斯·伍德工程制作。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Lansford of Wunderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wunderly的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰斯福德创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Balbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了一群自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，该党一直陷入一场残酷、混乱且有时令人兴奋的争斗之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《都市》节目中，由我萨拉·凯尼格为您讲述那些试图维持影响力却在过程中逐渐失控的人的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《都市》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在各大播客平台收听。
